name: my-flutter
description: Flutter and Dart knowledge for coding agents: five skills of rules and no process. design (the eight architecture principles: four layers, one source of truth, state at the right level, sealed async state, disposal, a testability seam for every unit), implement (rebuilds, build cost, jank, lists, images, animations, theming), riverpod (Riverpod 3 with code generation), test (what makes a Flutter test able to fail) and review (the rules per kind of unit, the three structural defects that block a change, dishonest tests). Use the skills alone, or with my-workflow, whose steps and agents pick them up by stack.
